reasoning: Healthcare and compliance interfaces demand trust, calm, and absolute clarity. A light theme with deep navy and soft gray bases prevents clinical coldness while ensuring accessibility. Avoided forbidden teal colors and opted for authoritative navy and emerald.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
surfaces.header: bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces.evidence_card: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 p-4 rounded-lg flex flex-col gap-3
surfaces.recording_banner: bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between

buttons.primary: bg-[#1E3A8A] text-white hover:bg-[#1E40AF] px-6 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 px-6 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-[#DC2626] text-white hover:bg-red-700 px-6 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors

accessibility.contrast_strategy: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. No pure gray-on-gray for vital data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-recording-btn').

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle transform translate-y-[-2px] for interactive cards.
motion_and_interactions.recording_state: Soft pulsing red indicator for active recording.

media_urls.description: Compliance theme visual used for login background or empty states.
Nurse care worker portrait for user profile or meeting attendee avatar.
African nurse portrait for user profile or reviewer avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main structural layout to ensure high customizability.
Implement the meeting view using a split layout: transcript on the left (lg:col-span-7) and evidence cards mapped to regulations on the right (lg:col-span-5).
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactive components like Dialogs, Dropdowns, and Tables, but style them to match the flat, 1px bordered, minimal-radius (8px) aesthetic.
The recording interface must feature prominent, unambiguous start/pause/stop controls using the red accent color, with a clear pulsing indicator when active.
Ensure all interactive components and vital information displays include a descriptive 'data-testid' attribute.
Apply 'Work Sans' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Enforce strict typographical hierarchy.
Do not use card components excessively. Use pure divs with flat backgrounds and subtle borders to prevent visual clutter in dense data views.
